input.summary: Ported fuzz.cu to idiomatic SYCL 2020 in migrated/fuzz.sycl.cpp. The port uses sycl::queue with profiling enabled, USM device allocations (malloc_device/free), a 1-D nd_range<1> kernel with a bounds check, and sycl::tanh. It has no dpct:: helpers, no DPCT_* macros and no dpct includes; it compiles with add_dpct_include=false and 0 diagnostics. Selector is default_selector_v, since gpu_selector_v found no GPU on this machine. Note: the migrated fuzz.dp.cpp from SYCLomatic was discarded because it still contained dpct helpers and an incorrect kernel launch. Edge case: n==0 writes an empty WAV without launching the kernel.
